FOUR DETAILS TO GET RIGHT

White fabric. Clear buying decisions.

Coverage & contours

Check dry and damp white fabric under normal lighting and full movement. Opacity and visible body contours depend on fit, stretch and fabric selection.

Matte fabric feel

Compare the hand feel, surface finish and exact GSM on a physical swatch. A smooth appearance alone does not prove breathability or drying performance.

Seams against skin

Review underarm and side seams during movement. Confirm the supplied 4-needle, 6-thread flatlock brief and finishing on the sample.

Collar & hem stability

Check the neckline after stretching and washing; review hem position during reaches and bends. Agree construction and measurements before production.

White rash guard buying questions

Is this white compression shirt see-through?

Opacity depends on fabric selection, fit, stretch, lighting and moisture. Approve a physical sample in dry and damp conditions, including full movement and body-contour checks. The photographs do not establish a zero-transparency guarantee.

What is the fabric specification?

The supplied development brief specifies 85% polyester / 15% spandex and a target range of 220–250 GSM. Confirm one exact weight, finish and fabric record before bulk production.

Will the seams chafe during BJJ or gym training?

Flat seams are intended to reduce raised contact points. Check the underarm and side seams against the skin during movement; comfort depends on fit and finishing. Zero chafing is not a tested guarantee.

Will the collar stretch out or the hem roll up?

Check neckline recovery and hem position during overhead reaches, bends and repeated washing. Approve the binding, hem length and stitching on the sample; this reference does not establish an anti-roll or anti-deformation test result.

Can I order private label rash guards with my logo?

Yes. Discuss chest and nape artwork, labels, fit and packaging for your OEM/ODM compression shirt project. Selected projects start at 10 pieces; confirm the minimum per style, design and colorway.

How should I choose a size?

The supplied model reference is 5 ft 11 in (180 cm), 195 lb (88 kg), chest 42 in (about 107 cm), wearing MD. Approve actual garment chest, body length, sleeve measurements and tolerances; request a looser fit if needed.

Is the video a fabric performance test?

No. It is a supplied promotional overview. Its stretch demonstration does not measure elastic recovery, opacity, wash durability, compression pressure or recovery benefits.
